$comment: Ordered staging installation for the dfabulous-staging project. NOT applied anywhere. Generated install files: supabase/staging/install/. Rebuild with `npm run staging:build`; verify with `npm run staging:check`.

steps.name: base_schema_derived
steps.why: Creates the tables that no repository migration creates (profiles, bookings, messages, payments, services, gallery, testimonials, site_settings, blocked_dates in its live shape). NOT AUTHORITATIVE: replace with a verified schema-only dump of production if available.

steps.name: security_remediation
steps.why: First definition of is_admin()/is_owner(), prevent_role_escalation() and its trigger, and the first profile/booking/message/content policies. MUST run before 20260814: it CREATEs POLICY "Users view profile" without dropping it first, so it fails with 42710 if 20260814 already ran (which is what filename order does). Must also run before steps 07-09, which undo its public insert/read grants.

steps.name: admin_rls_privileges
steps.why: Idempotent (DROP POLICY IF EXISTS before each CREATE). Redefines is_admin()/is_owner() as the EXISTS variant, so after this order the live variant is EXISTS (returns false, never NULL, without auth.uid()).

steps.name: admin_settings_privileges
steps.why: site_settings grants and admin-only read policy; runs after step 03, which re-creates a public read policy.

steps.name: blocked_dates_policies_excerpt
steps.from: ALTER TABLE public.blocked_dates ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
steps.why: Verbatim RLS, grants and policies for blocked_dates. The rest of the file is NOT installed: its CREATE TABLE has columns the application does not use, its index references a column that does not exist in the live shape, and create_booking_if_available() has a syntax error (missing semicolon before RETURN). Both functions are revoked from all roles by step 14 and unused by the application.

steps.name: seed_services
steps.why: Public marketing content (eight service rows). Not customer data.

steps.name: payments_rls_hardening

replace.from: to_regproc('public.is_admin()') IS NULL OR to_regproc('public.is_owner()') IS NULL
replace.to: to_regprocedure('public.is_admin()') IS NULL OR to_regprocedure('public.is_owner()') IS NULL

steps.why: RLS, policies and the immutability guard for payments. One labelled correction: the pre-flight check calls to_regproc('public.is_admin()'); to_regproc takes a bare name, so the parenthesised form never matches and the migration aborts even when the functions exist. to_regprocedure is the correct call.

steps.name: public_data_access_hardening

replace.from: to_regproc('public.is_admin()') IS NULL OR to_regproc('public.is_owner()') IS NULL
replace.to: to_regprocedure('public.is_admin()') IS NULL OR to_regprocedure('public.is_owner()') IS NULL

steps.why: Removes anon access and public insert policies for bookings/messages/payments/profiles/site_settings. Same labelled to_regproc -> to_regprocedure pre-flight correction as step 07.

steps.name: submission_service_role_privileges
steps.why: INSERT for service_role on bookings/messages (server-side submissions).

steps.name: admin_permissions_migration
steps.why: permissions, user_permissions, audit_logs, their policies and service_role grants (needs pgcrypto, available on Supabase).

steps.name: booking_references
steps.why: booking_reference column, sequence, assign trigger, unique index.

steps.name: booking_lifecycle_archive
steps.why: completed_at / archived_at columns (needed by the archive routes and the purge job).

steps.name: final_security_hardening
steps.why: Revokes direct EXECUTE on trigger/legacy functions and grants service_role its table privileges. Must run after steps 03 and 12 so the functions it revokes exist.

steps.name: booking_archive_purge_cron
steps.why: DEFERRED, not part of the initial staging sequence. Daily purge function and pg_cron job; the file enables the pg_cron extension. Nothing else depends on it. Install only after separate approval.
